evidence.title: TypeUI - Build better UI with AI

name: TypeUI
summary: Design skills and UI section prompt libraries for AI coding tools, installed by CLI or MCP server.
description: An AI-first platform of design skills (shipped as DESIGN.md and SKILL.md), UI section prompt libraries with layout counts, and a CLI (npx typeui.sh) with generate, update, randomize, list and pull commands. A hosted MCP server connects the guidance to 20+ coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, v0 and Lovable; the CLI and public registry are MIT, with an optional Pro tier.
contains: design skills in DESIGN.md and SKILL.md formats
UI prompt categories with layout counts: 17 hero, 20 pricing, 16 feature, 11 CTA, 12 content layouts
CLI commands: generate, update, randomize, list, pull <slug>
MCP integrations for 20+ AI coding tools
UI/UX fundamentals skill covering spacing, typography and color contrast
free MIT CLI and public registry; Pro version adds enhanced skills, layout prompts and a private community
